questions.question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The instructions on the bottle say – open the packet and poured the contents into hot water.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **poured the contents**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the verb tense.
 
• The verb "**say**" is in the present tense, indicating that the instructions are providing current guidance.
 
• The verb "**poured**" should be changed to "**pour**" to maintain proper **verb tense agreement**.
 
• The correct sentence should maintain consistency in verb tense. 
 
• **Corrected sentence**: "*The instructions on the bottle say – open the packet and pour the contents into hot water.*"
 
• Both "**open**" and "**pour**" are in the present tense, **ensuring agreement with the initial verb** "**say**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Verb tense agreement refers to the consistent use of verb forms in a sentence or a paragraph.
 
• It ensures that the timing of the actions described in the sentence is clear and logical.
 
• There are three primary verb tenses: past, present, and future, each with its own forms.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Rosie became an expert in the field of __painting by her.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **painting by herself**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has a grammatical error.
 
• The issue in this sentence is that the preposition "**by**" **is used without a suitable object**.
 
• When we use "**by**" to indicate the means or method by which something is done, we typically need an object after it. In this case, the object is missing.
 
• **Corrected sentence**:* Rosie became an expert in the field of painting by **herself**.*
 
• The corrected version adds the reflexive pronoun "**herself**" to indicate that Rosie became an expert through her own efforts.
 
• The corrected sentence adds the reflexive pronoun "**herself**" as the object of the preposition "**by**."

Therefore, the answer is **option 4**.
